headword: {温水洗浄便座|おんすいせんじょうべんざ}
reading: おんすいせんじょうべんざ
gloss: bidet toilet seat; warm-water washing toilet seat

definitions.explanation: A toilet seat with a built-in spray of warm water for washing. This is the generic, technical name used in catalogs, statistics and signs; in conversation people use the trademark ウォシュレット.
